`interface IShader`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`Shader`](/reference/bridges/shader/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IShader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/IShader.java)

A shader program of the render bridge, with its uniforms and samplers, bound through the render state.
